hypotheses.hypothesis: The shipping service is the direct latency bottleneck: its server-side p99 for POST /ship-order exceeds 5 seconds during the incident.
hypotheses.evidence: The p99 was approximately 8550 ms at 05:06:30Z and was below the threshold on the healthy baseline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The email service is under abnormal memory pressure: the email container exceeds 75 percent memory usage during the incident.
hypotheses.evidence: The email container was above 75 percent during the incident and near 57 percent at the baseline evaluation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Product catalog lock contention is the dominant cause: product-catalog server-side p99 exceeds one second during the incident.
hypotheses.evidence: The product-catalog GetProduct p99 was approximately 47 ms, so the comparison returned no series.
